subject: correlating factor scores from lavpredict different from CFA result

messages.author: f4f77115f6648fa1
messages.subject: correlating factor scores from lavpredict different from CFA result
parts:
On a whim, I decided to use lavpredict to get factor scores and then I ran a correlation analysis using the psych package. 

Many correlations are the same or similar but there are differences from what I get from the CFA I ran (and used within lavPredict). 

Why would that be?

messages.author: 23a4293d4c2373b0
messages.subject: Re: correlating factor scores from lavpredict different from CFA result
parts:
Do you mean "different from the correlations among the latent factors themselves"?

That's totally normal if that's what you mean, but the explanation is not really straightforward (it has to do with the error covariance matrix of the latent score estimates). I don't think I should be able to give a further explanation without too much statistical theory, but in summary you can safely assume it's not an error per se. In the most extreme cases, it may imply you have too many latent factors.

Hope that helps somehow!

messages.subject: Re: correlating factor scores from lavpredict different from CFA result
parts:
Yes, I think so. 

For example, when I use standardizedSolution(my.CFA.fit), the correlation between a working memory factor and fluid intelligence factor is .87
But when I use cor(lavPredict(my.CFA.fit)), the correlation between the two factors is now .89—a small difference but, it's something. In other cases, the difference might be as high as .05.

I mostly wanted to know if there was an error on my part and if there was something I could do.

Thanks!

-David
